scope: Offline saved-evidence analysis only; no live bench access
sanitization: Remove ANSI CSI for locating echo, then only observed CRCRLF soft-wraps; export counts/hashes/quote state, not command or runtime identities.

limited_ascii_quote_scan.limit: Static lexical scan only, not a BusyBox execution/reproduction or complete shell grammar proof.

stock_source_limit_comparison.limit: CMU vendor config/patches not acquired; matching cap is strong supporting inference, not proof of exact build configuration.

current_edit_line_limit: Trailing received0 is not proof of a typed0 or an empty buffer; its source is unknown.

ranked_source_supported_options.name: Clear current edit line then one EOF
ranked_source_supported_options.preconditions: Same incomplete quoted interactive parse, stock-compatible editor, VEOF=04, single owner, no intervening sends, coordinator approval.
ranked_source_supported_options.expected: Current line cleared without CR/LF; EOF causes syntax error and interactive parser reset before pending evaltree.

ranked_source_supported_options.name: One EOF alone if current edit line certified empty
ranked_source_supported_options.preconditions: Same unmatched quote AND certified empty edit line AND VEOF=04; current saved evidence does not certify emptiness.
ranked_source_supported_options.expected: Same EOF syntax-error path; EOF on nonempty line may merely delete a character.

ranked_source_supported_options.name: Retain stop state and obtain independent diagnostic context
ranked_source_supported_options.preconditions: Use only an already verified independent channel if available; none demonstrated here.
ranked_source_supported_options.expected: Read actual shell identity/tty control settings/build evidence before deciding another recovery action.

not_recommended: Repeated EOF after prompt could exit shell
verification_gate: No text commands until actual syntax error plus expected primary prompt; then separate coordinator-reviewed short identity transaction with explicit completion. Otherwise stop and preserve unknown.
